environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on Kubernetes (EKS 1.28) with a pod-level annotation referencing a custom RuntimeClass 'hardened-python' backed by gVisor (runsc) runtime handler. The node pool runs a custom AMI with a supplementary seccomp profile loaded at /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/microservice-restricted.json that denies connect(2), socket(2), and sendto(2) syscalls for AF_INET/AF_INET6 address families targeting RFC 1918 ranges and link-local (169.254.0.0/16) via a BPF argument inspection filter. The profile permits outbound connections only to the pod's configured service mesh sidecar (Envoy on 127.0.0.1:15001). Additionally, an istio-system VirtualService with a ServiceEntry restricts egress to explicitly declared upstream hosts. The seccomp profile JSON uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for socket/connect/sendto with conditional argument matching on sockaddr structures.
